name: smwgraphics-new-super-mario-bros-halloween-grassland
title: New Super Mario Bros. - Halloween Grassland
description:
A tileset inspired in the grassland levels from New Super Mario Bros. Includes big mushrooms that can be used as platforms, dried trees, fences and evil pumpkins.

Some layer 3 graphics are provided for the clouds that can be seen in the background, as well as an Uberasm code for an optional gradient.

Give credit if you use it, please ;)

Moderator note: best used with a status bar patch (Sprite Status Bar, Minimalist Status Bars, or Remove Status Bar) as the HUD will appear under the foreground.
